detail.title: Roar 4701 (301 Pro) | 4.1 Multimedia Speaker - 70W (Bluetooth, USB, AUX, & FM playback)
detail.overview: Elevate your audio experience with the Intex Roar 4701 (301 Pro), featuring a powerful 70W sound output and multiple playback options including Bluetooth, USB, AUX, and FM. The rotary-type volume, treble, and bass controls allow for customized sound adjustments. With an informative LED display and a fully functional IR remote, controlling your music has never been easier. The 10.16 cm (4-inch) woofer delivers deep bass and powerful sound effects, making it a perfect companion for any occasion.
features: 70W powerful sound output for superior audio quality
Multimode playability: Bluetooth, USB, AUX, and FM
Rotary controls for volume, treble, and bass adjustments
Fully functional IR remote for easy operation
Informative LED display for clear status updates
Portable design with a 10-meter Bluetooth range
High-performance 10.16 cm (4-inch) woofer for deep bass
Premium sound effects for rich and clear audio
